verified: gateway.thread.v3 now has strict command, query, subscription, snapshot, result, conflict and committed event messages for Thread list/detail/search/lineage/checkpoint/deletion impact and mutations.

Authenticated AgentThreadGatewayService verifies Owner/actor scope and deterministic access policy before dispatch; HTTP commands additionally require same-origin, CSRF and exact header/body idempotency-key agreement.

Every successful Thread mutation atomically commits the semantic receipt, reliable outbox event and cursor-ordered thread_gateway_events record in the same SQLite writer transaction under the original deployment authority fence.
SQLite close/reopen resumes from the persisted Thread cursor without replay loss, and an unavailable scoped cursor fails closed so HTTP SSE can require a bounded snapshot refresh.

The Control Center consumes authoritative list/detail/search/checkpoint/deletion snapshots, committed Thread events and revision conflicts for create, message admission, answer locale, rename, pin, archive/restore, Fork and deletion coordination.

Chromium and WebKit journeys cover stable Thread/Run/Approval/Task readback after browser close/reopen, durable cursor resume, offline reconnect, multi-tab mutation, explicit latest-revision reapply, search, archive/restore, deletion impact, checkpoint and Fork.

Browser persistence is limited to UI locale, bounded layout preferences, unsent per-Thread draft, v2/Thread cursors and body-free pending mutation identity; private committed history, raw search query and authority state are not persisted.

Raw search query admission protects the query as a private Payload and returns Agent-scoped HMAC token references from a shared projection tokenizer; browser-visible search results contain no raw query body.
